perspectives.title: Bond James
perspectives.summary: Automatic label unavailable; top terms: bond, james.

representative_posts.author: styfy.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I'm kinda up for a weirder James Bond. Robert Pattinson Named as the Next James Bond

representative_posts.author: blaw.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: i think that could suit pattinson's appearance and i think it would make for a new, potentially very fun and stylized run of bond movies.

representative_posts.author: beaucoupkevin.com
representative_posts.text: But really, each new Bond is a new Bond, that's it. (That's why I was really big on the assigned identity idea for the movies until SKYFALL said NYAAAH fuck you nerd.)

representative_posts.author: charlie-ashby.co.uk
representative_posts.text: It’s REALLY not that hard. Connery > Brosnan = same guy (1st series of cinematic stories). Daniel Craig had his own self-contained era which ends with his Bond seemingly meeting his end (2nd series of cinematic stories). Pattinson will presumably kickstart a new era - which can (hopefully)…

representative_posts.author: peanutbutterwhisky.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I think the pearl clenching that James Bond will prevent Robert Pattinson from doing "Weird little movies" as if he wasn't in The Odyssey, Dune: Part Three, The Drama, AND Primetime all this year. Not to mention he did press for those movies as he was shooting The Batman: Part II. He'll be fine.

representative_posts.author: selfindulgentclaptrap.com
representative_posts.text: *Guy who has never seen any Bond films beyond the Craig Bonds* "How are they going to explain how James Bond is not Daniel Craig?"

representative_posts.author: nerdmichele.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Psh. We all know Bond is a Time Lord.

representative_posts.author: thomaslstrickland.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: On the other hand, Pattinson’s character in Tenet (2020) is not entirely -not- a James Bond stand-in, so…

representative_posts.author: adampknave.com
representative_posts.text: there are references to the bad guy (an MI agent) having a code name etc. It was gonna be a whole thing, even though it didn't actually make sense, they were gonna do it. But Connery didn't wanna in it, so it fell apart and Bond movies stayed as they are - EACH BOND ALONE, in their own universe.

representative_posts.author: djgreenflow.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Stop trying to make continuity happen - The only way these films make sense is if "007 - James Bond" is a title and it gets passed between agents. Stop trying to make Sean Connery and Robert Pattinson the same person.

representative_posts.author: dmr09.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I think most people who are like “nope as Bond” have truly only seen him in twilight He’ll be fine. Folks had stuff to say about Daniel Craig, Timothy Dalton, and even Pierce Brosnan

representative_posts.author: blakeyrat.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: (The point being: Bond movies don't have a continuity! And some of them are outright ridiculous science fiction! What the fuck is wrong with The Guardian, are they infants?)

representative_posts.author: shamontiel.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I'm trying not to say anything catty regarding news of Robert Pattison being the next James Bond. I'll keep it light and say that even in my Twilight fandom days, I was all about Taylor Lautner. I haven't been Team Edward a day in my life! #TeamJacob I see why John Singleton wanted to work with him.

representative_posts.author: lethalityjane.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This is easily solved by my head canon that "James Bond" is just an alias that the chubby nerds at MI6 keep around for when they accidentally get a sexy recruit every other decade.

representative_posts.author: notsoskinnypete.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It’s not like Bond has ever been cannon. At the start of Casino Royale we see him earn his 00 status. New Bond has always equaled complete reboot in my mind.

representative_posts.author: larkistin89.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This is actually an argument my dad, my mum and I have on a regular basis. My parents have been the biggest Bond fans for forever. I grew up with them rewatching these films over and over. But CraigBond’s death was the dealbreaker for my dad. And neither I nor my mum can really understand.

representative_posts.author: burhanplays.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I've never been into James Bond and Robert Pattinson landing the role didn't move the needle for me. But I just found out that Dennis Villeneuve is directing the next one. Now that's interesting.

representative_posts.author: likeadeuce.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Hats off to the person who pointed out that Josh O'Connor turning down the ongoing role of Bond does not prevent him from showing up as a one-off love interest in a Pattinson film

representative_posts.author: crepuscularflow.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: So, um, this might be a surprise to the author, but there isn’t a coherent Bond universe like Marvel or Star Trek or some shit. It’s just a bunch of movies about British spies that gets rebooted every time there’s a new actor hired for the role. I’m not even sure they’re consistent within that.

representative_posts.author: kaiten9653.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: James Bond, a franchise noted for its realism and dedication to continuity.

representative_posts.author: sogerald.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I didn't miss armchair movie critics swarming to say the new Bond choice is terrible; then they see the movie and completely change their minds. "Daniel Craig is my all-time favorite. Sorry, Sir Sean."

representative_posts.author: storyslug.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I dunno, in "GoldenEye" Bond had been there since the Cold War and Judi Dench was a brand new M cramping his style, yet in "Casino Royale" he was a brand new 00 agent and Judi Dench played an established M who'd been there for years. representative_posts.text: Some public subsidies for journalism is good and has worked (imperfectly) in many countries. Privitization is not the answer. But if Dems are able to re-legislate funding for public media, I think they will need to open the door for different kinds of journalists on a variety of (digital) media.

representative_posts.author: micahloewinger.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I love radio. But with obvious media consumption trends, I don't see how we can advocate for using public money to simply recreate the old system.
